description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different configurations of the LLaMA-2 family models in solving math word problems, as measured by the CoLeG-E and CoLeg-R metrics. The vertical axis represents the percentage of correct answers, ranging from 0 to 80%, while the horizontal axis lists three different model scales: LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B. Each model scale is tested with four configurations: no SFT, SFT on D0, SFT on D0, D1, and SFT on D0, D1, D2. The bars are color-coded to distinguish between the configurations, with no SFT in light blue, SFT on D0 in yellow, SFT on D0, D1 in orange, and SFT on D0, D1, D2 in red. The chart shows that the performance generally increases with the addition of SFT, with the highest performance observed in the LLaMA-2-70B model with SFT on D0, D1, D2. The values for each bar are not provided, but the chart indicates a trend of increasing performance with larger model scales and the application of SFT.
